profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer on the Android Runtime for Chrome team.

- Formerly lead for Android Desktop AVD
- Currently developing Picture-in-Picture for Android Desktop Mode

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- SWE for first launch of Desktop AVD
- Lead for Desktop AVD, drove two dessert version launches in Android Studio

positions.title: Computer Science Department Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Assisted Computer Science students with their coursework through dedicated tutoring hours; provided assignment grading and feedback for Artificial Intelligence and Data Structures students.

positions.title: Math Department Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Provided tutoring and grading for Calculus I, Business Calculus, and Calculus for Life Sciences students.

positions.title: Webmaster - University Honors Program
positions.description: Maintained, designed and ran the University Honors Program website and the Honors student publication website.

positions.title: RAINS Undergraduate Research Fellow
positions.description: Participated in the LMU Summer Undergraduate Research Program and worked with Evan Mitchell to create a web application that generates 3D music visualization.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Improved users' gaming experience by implementing gamepad rumble support for Android applications running on Chrome OS. Took charge of the entire development process, including designing the pipeline and writing implementation, tests and documentation.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Implemented a new feature to allow for automated handling of the flagging of problematic data on the Google Ads team. Used Java and SQL to perform back-end processing to record flagging events and created reporting dashboards for the team to monitor and adjust processes as needed.

positions.title: Engineering Practicum Intern
positions.description: Worked on the kids accounts team to migrate all existing kid sign-in/sign-up pages to a new API using HTML and JavaScript. The project consolidates the previously separate flows into a single, unified framework and improves developer efficiency by decreasing line counts and references to multiple directories. In production, the project affects more than a million users through the Family Link app on Android alone.

positions.title: Program Participant
positions.description: Participated in an intensive programming institute learning web app development in HTML, CSS, Javascript, Python and GoogleAppEngine from Google engineers and Loyola Marymount University faculty. Created the web-app Hobyn.

positions.title: Director Of Public Relations
positions.description: In charge of all forms of communication within the organization and also between the organization and third parties. Handled the organization's official Facebook and email account to inform members of upcoming activities and to answer any enquiries.

positions.title: Writer
positions.description: Wrote 2-3 articles monthly to be published online at the student publication website - a few of which have been featured in the annual hardcopy for the year 2016.

honors.title: Best Overall Hack Winner, LMUHacks 2020
honors.description: Winner of Best Overall Hack at LMUHacks 2020, out of approximately 20 teams.

honors.title: First Place Overall Winner, RoseHack 2020
honors.description: Winner of First Place Overall Hack at RoseHack 2020, out of approximately 40 participating teams.

volunteerExperiences.description: I participated in various volunteering events held by Sunway Student Volunteers, including the 2015 and 2016 Standard Chartered Kuala Lumpur Marathon. I was awarded the Gold Medal for achieving more than 60 volunteer hours.

projects.title: China Shop Bully
projects.description:
Project created with Maddie Louis and Kaitlyn Behrens for RoseHack 2020. Won first place overall hack out of approximately 40 teams.

A web game created with Javascript and HTML5 canvas.
The player is a bull let loose in the china shop. The objective of the game is to smash as much china as possible, and get to the next level before the shopkeeper catches you.
The game can only be played on a computer browser, and is best played with audio on.

projects.title: Plantydex
projects.description:
Project created with Evan Mitchell and Kaitlyn Behrens at LMUHacks 2020. Won the Best Overall Hack award sponsored by TechEmpower out of approximately 15 teams.

The project is a web app that allows you to upload pictures of plants and store it in your collection. The web app uses an API to recognize the species of plant from the photo and display additional info about the plant.
